# Corezoid AI Plugin

> Official Claude Code plugin for the Corezoid Actor Engine. Provides skills and MCP tools for creating, editing, reviewing, and managing Corezoid business processes directly from the IDE.

## Skills

- [corezoid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid/SKILL.md): Corezoid basics: platform model, .conv.json, nodes, MCP tools, validation
- [corezoid-access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-access/SKILL.md): Share processes, folders, stages, projects; groups, API-key users, invites, access audit
- [corezoid-alias-manager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-alias-manager/SKILL.md): Process aliases (short_name, conv[@alias]): create, list, modify, delete, link; callback hash / Direct URL
- [corezoid-api-connector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-api-connector/SKILL.md): Build a process that calls the Corezoid public API (/api/2/json)
- [corezoid-connector-create](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-connector-create/SKILL.md): Atomic connector process for ONE endpoint of any HTTP API (Corezoid /api/2/json too), from docs or OpenAPI
- [corezoid-create](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-create/SKILL.md): Create a new process from scratch
- [corezoid-dashboard-manager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-dashboard-manager/SKILL.md): Dashboards and charts bound to process nodes, real-time, drill-down
- [corezoid-describe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-describe/SKILL.md): Set the short description of a process, folder or project without changing logic
- [corezoid-edit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-edit/SKILL.md): Modify an existing process: add/remove nodes, change logic, fix errors
- [corezoid-edit-bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-edit-bot/SKILL.md): Edit or fix a bot built by corezoid-gen-bot: commands, copy, keyboards, languages, wiring, deploy
- [corezoid-feedback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-feedback/SKILL.md): Report plugin bugs/ideas to the Corezoid team
- [corezoid-gen-bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-gen-bot/SKILL.md): Messenger bot (Telegram, Viber, Apple, FB) over existing processes
- [corezoid-git-context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-git-context/SKILL.md): Update _ext/docs/*.md in the git mirror after a session with real deploys or decisions
- [corezoid-gitcall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-gitcall/SKILL.md): Git Call node: custom code (Python, Go, JS, PHP, Java, Dockerfile) as a process step
- [corezoid-init](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-init/SKILL.md): Connect to Corezoid: login (OAuth or API key), workspace and stage, project pull
- [corezoid-lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-lifecycle/SKILL.md): Pause, resume or move processes and folders, only on explicit request
- [corezoid-node-layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-node-layout/SKILL.md): Auto-arrange node x/y before pushing a process you built, or when asked to arrange nodes or fix overlaps
- [corezoid-process-optimizer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-process-optimizer/SKILL.md): Optimize a process: fewer tacts, merged nodes, data flow, resilience, Code → Condition + Set Parameters
- [corezoid-process-tech-writer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-process-tech-writer/SKILL.md): Document a process: Markdown doc plus JSON with node and parameter descriptions
- [corezoid-project-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-project-review/SKILL.md): Audit a whole project or folder across processes
- [corezoid-retro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-retro/SKILL.md): End-of-session retrospective: route learnings to CLAUDE.md, team feedback, permissions or memory
- [corezoid-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-review/SKILL.md): Review one process: issues, hardcoded values, what it does
- [corezoid-state-diagram-create](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-state-diagram-create/SKILL.md): New state diagram (conv_type "state"): state machine, status store by ref
- [corezoid-state-diagram-edit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-state-diagram-edit/SKILL.md): Modify a state diagram: states, transitions, side effects, api_callback wiring
- [corezoid-variable-manager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/corezoid-variable-manager/SKILL.md): Env variables (env_var) for URLs, tokens, API keys, secrets: create, list, modify, delete
- [marketplace-publish-validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/skills/marketplace-publish-validation/SKILL.md): Pre-publication check of a project or folder for the Corezoid marketplace

## MCP Tools

The plugin bundles a Go MCP server (`convctl`) with these tools:

- **add-chart**: Add a chart to a Corezoid dashboard. chart_type must be one of: column, pie, funnel, table (action of `cz-dashboards`)
- **add-to-group**: Add a user (or API key user) to a group (action of `cz-access`)
- **clean-process**: Remove nodes with no traffic in the last N days (default 90) from a Corezoid process, saving a reviewable proposal as <ID>_<title>.cleaned.json — NOT a .conv.json, so it never collides with the pulled process; pass that path explicitly to lint-process/push-process to deploy it
- **create-alias**: Create a short alias for a Corezoid process
- **create-api-key**: Create a new API key in the workspace (action of `cz-access`)
- **create-communications-orchestrator**: Create a Communications Orchestrator: a multi-platform robot handling Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Viber and Apple Messages for Business
- **create-dashboard**: Create a new Corezoid dashboard for visualizing process node metrics (action of `cz-dashboards`)
- **create-folder**: Create a new folder inside a parent Corezoid folder (action of `cz-structure`)
- **create-group**: Create a new user group in the current workspace (action of `cz-access`)
- **create-process**: Create a new empty process (conv_type "process") inside a Corezoid folder
- **create-project**: Create a new Corezoid project (with optional stages) inside a workspace (action of `cz-structure`)
- **create-snapshot**: Snapshot a process's current server state as a manual checkpoint before experiments. push-process already auto-snapshots existing processes (action of `cz-snapshots`)
- **create-state-diagram**: Create a new empty state diagram (conv_type "state") inside a Corezoid folder
- **create-variable**: Create an environment variable in the current Corezoid stage (action of `cz-variables`)
- **cz-access**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **cz-dashboards**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **cz-git-context**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **cz-snapshots**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **cz-structure**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **cz-tasks**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **cz-variables**: Router tool: call it as {"action": "<action>", "args": {…}}
- **delete-api-key**: Delete an API key (action of `cz-access`)
- **delete-folder**: Move a Corezoid folder to the recycle bin (Trash) (action of `cz-structure`)
- **delete-group**: Delete a user group (action of `cz-access`)
- **delete-process**: Move a Corezoid process (or state diagram) to the recycle bin (Trash)
- **delete-project**: Move a Corezoid project to the recycle bin (Trash) (action of `cz-structure`)
- **delete-snapshot**: Delete a snapshot by its obj_id (action of `cz-snapshots`)
- **delete-task**: Delete a task from a process (action of `cz-tasks`)
- **delete-variable**: PERMANENTLY delete a Corezoid environment variable from the current stage (action of `cz-variables`)
- **deploy-stage**: Deploy (promote) one stage's processes onto another within a Corezoid project — e.g. develop → production
- **find-principal**: Search users, groups or API keys in the workspace by substring (action of `cz-access`)
- **get-chart**: Get a single chart with its series data (action of `cz-dashboards`)
- **get-dashboard**: Get a Corezoid dashboard with its charts and series (action of `cz-dashboards`)
- **get-node-stat**: Return time-series statistics (in/out counts) for a node over a time range — the last 24 hours unless start/end are given. node_id is the ID shown in the Corezoid UI archive URL (/diagram/{node_id}/archive). ops[0]['data'] contains [{"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","in":N,"out":M}] for non-zero buckets. ops[0]['title'] is the node title (action of `cz-tasks`)
- **get-snapshot**: Get one snapshot's node list, as it existed at snapshot time, for diffing against the current process (action of `cz-snapshots`)
- **git-pull-context**: Clone or pull the Corezoid git mirror for the current workspace into .git-context/. Requires git_url, api_login, and api_secret to be set in the current Folder in ~/.corezoid/config.json (action of `cz-git-context`)
- **git-push-context**: Commit and push local _ext/ changes to the Corezoid git mirror (action of `cz-git-context`)
- **invite-user**: Invite an external email to the workspace AND share a process/folder/stage/project with them in one call (action of `cz-access`)
- **layout-process**: Auto-arrange a process's node coordinates into a clean, readable layout (waterfall for simple trees, layered+error-rail for meshes, aligned table/star grids for region bundles)
- **lint-process**: Check a local process file without calling the server (pull-process first; pass process_path or process_id)
- **list-aliases**: List the aliases (short_name -> target process) defined in a Corezoid project's stage (action of `cz-structure`)
- **list-api-keys**: List API keys visible in the current workspace (action of `cz-access`)
- **list-folders**: List the immediate children of a Corezoid folder (subfolders + processes + state diagrams) (action of `cz-structure`)
- **list-group-objects**: List the processes (conv objects) currently shared with a group (action of `cz-access`)
- **list-groups**: List user groups visible in the current workspace (action of `cz-access`)
- **list-node-tasks**: Return tasks currently sitting in a specific node of a process (action of `cz-tasks`)
- **list-projects**: Return the list of projects inside a Corezoid workspace (company), sorted by title (action of `cz-structure`)
- **list-shares**: List users, API keys and groups that currently have access to a Corezoid object (action of `cz-access`)
- **list-snapshots**: List all snapshots for a process (action of `cz-snapshots`)
- **list-stages**: Return the list of stages (environments) inside a Corezoid project (action of `cz-structure`)
- **list-task-history**: Return the execution history (node path) for a task (action of `cz-tasks`)
- **list-variables**: List all environment variables (env_var) in the current Corezoid stage: short_name, obj_id, data_type (raw/json), env_var_type (visible/secret), title, value and change time (action of `cz-variables`)
- **list-workspaces**: Return the list of Corezoid workspaces (companies) available to the authenticated user (action of `cz-structure`)
- **login**: Authenticate with Corezoid
- **logout**: Log out: delete the entry for the current directory in ~/.corezoid/config.json (token or API key, workspace, stage, git settings)
- **modify-api-key**: Update title and/or description of an existing API key (action of `cz-access`)
- **modify-chart**: Modify an existing Corezoid chart (action of `cz-dashboards`)
- **modify-folder**: Rename a Corezoid folder and/or update its description (action of `cz-structure`)
- **modify-group**: Rename a user group and/or update its description (action of `cz-access`)
- **modify-project**: Update a Corezoid project's title, short_name and/or description (action of `cz-structure`)
- **modify-task**: Modify an existing task's data; at least one of task_id or ref is required (action of `cz-tasks`)
- **modify-variable**: Modify a Corezoid environment variable in the current stage: its value, description (display title), data_type (raw/json), and/or rename it (new_name) (action of `cz-variables`)
- **move-folder**: Move (reparent) one existing NORMAL Corezoid folder to another folder in the configured workspace, preserving its folder ID and descendants; NOT copy, import, or deploy (action of `cz-structure`)
- **move-process**: Move (reparent) one existing Corezoid process/state diagram to another folder in the configured workspace, preserving its object ID and graph; NOT copy, import, or deploy (action of `cz-structure`)
- **patch-process**: Change a few nodes of a pulled process file in place, by node id or title, instead of rewriting the file or sending the whole JSON as push-process content: ops set/add/remove and process keys
- **pause-process**: Pause one Corezoid process without changing or deploying its graph
- **pull-folder**: Recursively export all processes from a Corezoid folder/stage to a local directory
- **pull-process**: Export a single Corezoid process definitions to a JSON file
- **push-process**: Validate (lint-process) and deploy a process file to Corezoid
- **read-context-file**: Read a file from .git-context/ of the current workspace (git mirror local copy) (action of `cz-git-context`)
- **remove-from-group**: Remove a user from a group (action of `cz-access`)
- **resume-process**: Resume (activate) one paused/debug Corezoid process without changing or deploying its graph
- **run-task**: Run a task on a deployed process and wait for it to reach a final node
- **send-feedback**: Submit user feedback about plugin behavior to Corezoid
- **set-dashboard-layout**: Save chart positions on a dashboard grid (action of `cz-dashboards`)
- **set-stage-immutable**: Set a stage's immutable (read-only) flag (action of `cz-structure`)
- **share-object**: Grant or revoke access to a Corezoid object (process/folder/stage/project) for a user, API key, or group (action of `cz-access`)
- **show-folder**: Show metadata for a single Corezoid folder: title, obj_type (0 normal, 2 project, 3 stage), parent folder ID and parent type (action of `cz-structure`)
- **show-process**: Show a Corezoid process's own metadata (title, description, status, conv_type, owner_id/owner_login, project_id, stage_id, immutable) without exporting its scheme (action of `cz-structure`)
- **show-project**: Show a Corezoid project's metadata and the stages available to the caller (action of `cz-structure`)
- **show-task**: Return the current state of a single task — data, obj_id (task_id), node_id and status — resolved by task_id and/or ref (action of `cz-tasks`)
- **update-context-file**: Write or append to a file inside _ext/ of the git mirror local copy (.git-context/) (action of `cz-git-context`)

## Documentation

- [Node Structures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/docs/node-structures.md): JSON schemas for all 24 Corezoid node types
- [Variables Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/docs/variables-guide.md): Environment variable syntax `{{env_var[@name]}}`
- [Process Docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/docs/process/): Process format, validation rules, and error handling
- [Node Docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/corezoid-ai-plugin/main/plugins/corezoid/docs/nodes/): Per-node-type documentation (24 types)
